routeAdjustment: Reuse the already proved finiteness over each transcendental coordinate. Select only the actual Dedekind-chart center proofs. This replaces the external minimal-polynomial coefficient transfer, general ramification fibers and rational-place classification for the finite-support obligation. Exact place-order normalization is preserved.
discharged: Every function in the actual original modular function field has only finitely many nonzero normalized place orders. For a transcendental function the proved finite coordinate extension gives a Dedekind integral-closure chart. Actual places containing the chart are identified with their actual prime centers. Pinned finiteness of prime ideal factors bounds the positive support; inversion handles negative support. Algebraic functions have order zero at every actual place. No finite-support or place-classification premise remains.
remaining: The degree-zero principal-divisor product formula remains unproved. Canonical divisors, Riemann--Roch, geometric genus and analytic cusp-form realization remain required for the matching dimension lower bound. Period surjectivity, Hecke/Galois realization, the adic system and symmetric-power continuation remain open. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
